T1: "Gib mir das Beispiel, nicht die These darüber" asks for evidence without affirming or denying the claim.
[held] T1: Demands a concrete example: "Welche Rahmenbedingung meinst du genau".
T1: Opens the inquiry and does not treat anything as settled.
T1: Gives a direct demand with no narration of technique.
T1: Uses "Rahmenbedingung" in line with the visitor's framing.
T1: "Konkret werden." is short, sharp and has no preamble.
T2: Declares "da schlägst du eine Brücke, die nicht hält" and "Das kann nicht dein Ernst sein", handing over the verdict before the question.
[held] T2: Offers a concrete reductio and asks the visitor to show where the business decision hides "in diesem zweiten Schritt".
T2: Presses on the weak link and does not close the exchange.
T2: Contains no narration of its own pedagogical move.
T2: Correctly separates the frequency choice from the timing constraint that follows from "Setup-Time, Gate-Delay und Clock-Period".
T2: Runs to two long paragraphs and opens with the filler "A-ha", which is too heavy for reading on a phone.
T3: Puts the judgement back to the visitor with "prüf den mal selbst" and asks a question.
[held] T3: Brings in a new angle, whether the visitor had any decision authority over the frequency.
T3: Acknowledges the shift in the claim and then tests it further.
T3: Recaps the session: "Du bist von ... zu ... gewandert. Das ist ein anderer Vorwurf, gut."
T3: Applies Auftragsklärung and Entwurfsraum appropriately to the question of who decides what.
T3: Opens with the preamble "Das ist schon deutlich schärfer, ja" and runs to two long paragraphs.
T4: Opens with "Gut erkannt, das ist der sauberere Punkt", affirming the visitor's conclusion.
[held] T4: Despite the affirmation, it adds the new distinction "falsch, oder ... nur unvollständig" and probes further.
T4: Keeps the inquiry open with "bevor du das ganz ablegst".
T4: Narrates its own move: "lass mich noch einen Schritt weiterbohren".
T4: Uses Rahmenbedingungen and Entwurfsauftrag coherently.
T4: Two long paragraphs that open with praise rather than the sharpest counter-move.
